status_why: wsrep_on is OFF globally: this node is still in the cluster and applies the other nodes' writes, but writes from sessions started since are not replicated, so the data can diverge. SET GLOBAL wsrep_on=ON replicates new sessions again; check the tables written meanwhile.

findings.title: This node does not replicate
findings.text: wsrep_on is OFF globally: this node is still in the cluster and applies the other nodes' writes, but writes from sessions started since are not replicated, so the data can diverge. SET GLOBAL wsrep_on=ON replicates new sessions again; check the tables written meanwhile.

notes: mysql.wsrep_cluster_members reports port 0 for galera-1, galera-2, galera-3, so only the host is shown: with wsrep_node_incoming_address AUTO the node takes the port mysqld had when wsrep started. Set wsrep_node_incoming_address to host:port to report the client port.
Failures tolerated assumes equal pc.weight on every node (the default): a Primary component needs more than half of the total weight.
Galera exposes only this node's own state: the other nodes are listed as members of the component without a verdict. Connect to a node to inspect it.
